name: ogbn_arxiv_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

The supplied main backbone uses the manuscript's T=32, alpha=0.1, tau=0.9 and transport spectral norm 1.6. Width, optimizer settings and initialization are declared reconstruction choices. This unified entry point uses exact remaining-tail evaluation and a fixed loaded deployment graph. The paper's registered corruption mixture and specialized interval-tube/window executor are available through the separate native arxiv implementation; see the native commands in docs/ARRHENIUS.md. Results from these paths must be identified by backend and protocol.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
